pair_comparison.scope_of_negative_result: No such ordinary specialization is identified in the inspected actual source/neighbor material. This is not a proof of formal logical independence.
pair_comparison.target_first_reason: A weighted edge cut counts every crossing incidence with its fixed conductance; an outer vertex boundary counts a shared outside neighbor once. The infima are taken for these different functionals. Setting c=D=1 in6.2 gives an unweighted edge assertion, not6.4.6.4 does not directly recover all edge-weighted summable-incidence networks.
pair_comparison.simple_bounds_not_full_coverage: Usual edge/vertex boundary comparison bounds do not identify the two optimal constants or transfer strict nonattainment at the exact constant. They are not a declared covering specialization.
pair_comparison.no_invented_reduction: No graph-splitting or auxiliary construction is created. A capacity reduction alone would also need to preserve the relevant transitivity, full target range and exact infimum/nonattainment property; no such supplied ordinary reduction is established here.
pair_comparison.shared_core_and_difference: Both printed alternatives start with an optimal global dual flow and exploit transitivity of a hypothetical minimizing set. The edge route uses an acyclic flow and an automorphic backward orbit contradiction; the vertex route uses vertex saturation and divergence-preserving cycle/bi-infinite-path deformation. This shared prefix is recorded; route difference is not used by itself as a semantic-distinctness argument.
